_: The ceremonies of Solitaire Agile (D-SA2; docs/modules/solitaire-agile.md, "The file shape, and how a standup is read"): a ceremony is a named slot list, declared here and filled from the tracker by the Ritual Engine. Both halves read this file; a slot list is never typed in code. M0 declared the standup; V1 adds triage: its slots are the three questions asked of each open issue, severities the labels a severity answer may write (one at a time), deepWaterLabel the label that marks the top size (D-TA3, D-TA4), and text the words both halves render -- {placeholders} filled by each half, tags joined with ', '. The standup's kinds are what a dressed sentence may count by kind ('smashed two bugs'): an issue is of a kind when it carries the kind's label, a card when its type is the kind's type (ignoring case); one and many are the nouns the dress guard reads. Retro and planning join as rows.
